Wystan is a Welsh name derived from the Old Welsh elements ‘wyst’ meaning ‘hospitable’ and ‘stan’ meaning ‘stone’ or ‘rock’. It is often interpreted as ‘friend of the forest’ or ‘hospitable one’. The name has been popular in Wales and among Welsh diaspora communities.
